review_scope: Only the attached hub linkage, closed/open relationship, tape clearance, and alleged underside evidence.

frame_observations.observed_fact: The frame is a close side view of the wave seam and lower side panel; it is not an underside view and does not expose pads or a recessed bottom text area.
frame_observations.reason: The extraction describes underside pads and a central inset that are not visible at the inspected timestamp.

frame_observations.observed_fact: The hub assembly is raised but remains connected at the rear interior; a broad flat black linkage extends from the rear hinge area toward the hub core.
frame_observations.reason: Attachment and one-pivot motion are visible, but the dark linkage profile and exact hinge axle are partly occluded.

frame_observations.observed_fact: In the closed overhead view without tape, the radial core sits in the channel and a longitudinal support links it to a rectangular rear hinge housing.
frame_observations.reason: The connected support is visible across a second state/view, while its lower surface remains hidden.

frame_observations.observed_fact: A standard tape roll is mounted on the attached hub and nests centrally between the side rails without detaching the hub from the housing.
frame_observations.reason: The mounted relationship is visible, but the exact radial clearance cannot be measured from this perspective frame.

accepted_target_specific_conclusion: Replace the floating annular hub blockout with a radial core plus a broad, flat, rear-hinged support assembly. Keep the exact hinge axle, underside ribs, and tolerance reversible.
claim_boundary: This review can drive the current target's reversible blockout. It does not promote a general mechanism-modeling skill, validate the rejected underside claim, or establish hidden dimensions.
